blocks.orig: Lux* Marijani is a beach resort in Pwani Mchangani on Zanzibar’s east coast. It has 82 rooms in different categories, but all decorated in warm, earthy tones. Some rooms are more basic with lovely large beds and showers, while others have a freestanding bathtub and the most luxurious ones even a private indoor and outdoor lounge, plunge pool and kitchen.
blocks.html: On Zanzibar’s east coast, in Pwani Mchangani, you find the beach resort Lux* Marijani. Its 82 rooms come in several categories, all furnished in warm, earthy colours. The simpler rooms have lovely big beds and showers, others add a freestanding bathtub, and the most luxurious even have a private indoor and outdoor lounge, a plunge pool and a kitchen.

blocks.orig: In the resort, you can relax on the magnificent terrace and spend a lovely day by the pool or in the spa and wellness centre. The private beach area with sun loungers, beach chairs and pavilions also invites you to linger and jump into the clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean. End your day with a delicious dinner on the terrace and a digestif in the sundowner lounge. It’s hard to find more peace, quiet and serenity in your vacation…
blocks.html: At the resort you can unwind on the splendid terrace and spend a pleasant day at the pool or in the spa and wellness centre. The private stretch of beach with sun loungers, beach chairs and pavilions also tempts you to stay a while and take a dip in the clear blue Indian Ocean. Finish the day with a tasty dinner on the terrace and an after-dinner drink in the sundowner lounge. You will struggle to find more peace, quiet and calm on your holiday…
